Premise: card body (maintainer 「这些问题都需要立卡处理」) and triage 6685125943 (p1 kept). Two tools follow.
  - Read a file: for an attachment or file field the caller can see, return its text (PDF and Word extracted; images as an image block where the protocol allows), plus a short-lived download link. Access follows the record, under a named size cap.
  - Attach through a one-time upload link: for a record the caller may edit, return a short-lived, single-use link bound to that record and field. The upload counts toward the storage quota.
  Direct protocol upload is out of scope. Cloud's half (quota, bucket) goes to objectstack-ai/cloud only if the design needs it.
